description: Find house plans in the Intertwine House Plans catalog (68 plan sets by residential designer Angela Kamer) that match a buyer's requirements. Use this first when someone describes the house they want: bedrooms, baths, size, width, an elevated or pilings foundation, an elevator, a drive-under garage, an in-law suite, a garage apartment, a style or a budget. All filters are optional and combine with AND; leave out any the buyer didn't mention. Returns { count, plans[] } where count is the total number of matches and plans holds up to `limit` of them in catalog order, each with name, subtitle, bedrooms (and optional bedrooms), baths, heated sq ft, stories, footprint, foundation, features, starting price (plus the regular price when a sale is on), one photo URL and the plan's page URL. Use get_plan for everything about one plan, plans_for_lot when the buyer gives lot dimensions, and list_features to see which style and feature values exist. Read-only; it never buys or changes anything.

driveUnder.description: true for plans with a drive-under garage beneath the living floors.

elevated.description: true for plans built on a raised foundation (pilings, piers or an elevated base) for flood zones and coastal lots; false for plans that are not raised.

elevator.description: true for plans with an elevator.

feature.description: One style or feature to filter by, case-insensitive. Use pilings and stilts or elevated coastal for raised coastal homes. list_features shows how many plans carry each value.

garageADU.description: true for detached garage plans that include an apartment or ADU above or beside the garage.

inLawSuite.description: true for plans with a bedroom and full bath set apart for a guest or relative.

limit.description: How many plans to return (1 to 25). count still reports every match.

maxBedrooms.description: Most bedrooms, counting only standard bedrooms.

maxDepthFt.description: Deepest the house footprint can be, in feet.

maxPrice.description: Highest starting price in US dollars, using the current price (sale price when a sale is on).

maxSqFt.description: Largest heated (living) area in square feet.

maxWidthFt.description: Widest the house footprint can be, in feet. For a full lot check with setbacks, use plans_for_lot instead.

minBathrooms.description: Fewest bathrooms; half baths count as 0.5 (for example 2.5).

minBedrooms.description: Fewest bedrooms. Counts optional bedrooms, so a 3-bedroom plan with an optional 4th matches minBedrooms 4.

minSqFt.description: Smallest heated (living) area in square feet. Garages, porches and ground-level storage aren't included.

stories.description: Exact number of stories as the plan lists them (the catalog has 1- and 2-story plans).

text.description: Words to find in a plan's name, other published names, subtitle or summary, for example porch, courtyard or Lambert's Cottage. Case-insensitive substring match.

name: search_plans
title: Search house plans
